paper_title: Asymptotic Determinacy of Path Queries using Union-of-Paths Views
statement: The case of n = 9. There remains only a single unsolved case, which is n = 9. This qualifies as a “small query” for the view V: a query for which we are unable to either build a generic counter-example, as in Section 4.2, or provide a generic rewriting, as in Section 4.3. We actually proved that V 6 Q = {9}. However, the smallest counter-example that we know is a pair of databases of 154 nodes each, that were built by hand through a very tedious trial and error process and checked by a computer program. At this time, we are unfortunately unable to provide any technique to generate such a counter-example for other views and queries. We conjecture that the combinatorial complexity of these “small queries” might be way higher than what we have dealt with so far.
